project_name: Erdős 33: additive complements to the squares

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos33.fibBlockWidth
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos33.fibBlockWidth (j : Nat) : Nat :=
  fun j => Nat.fib (HAdd.hAdd j 2)

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos33.vanDoornBlockStart
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos33.vanDoornBlockStart (M : Nat → Nat) (j : Nat) : Nat :=
  fun M j => Nat.rec 0 (fun k acc => HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd acc (HPow.hPow (M k) 2)) (HMul.hMul 2 (M k))) j

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos33.vanDoornBlock
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos33.vanDoornBlock (B M : Nat) : Set Nat :=
  fun B M => Set.ofPred fun a => And (LE.le B a) (LE.le a (HAdd.hAdd B (HMul.hMul 2 M)))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos33.vanDoornUnion
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos33.vanDoornUnion (M : Nat → Nat) : Set Nat :=
  fun M => Set.iUnion fun j => Erdos33.vanDoornBlock (Erdos33.vanDoornBlockStart M j) (M j)

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos33.prefixCount
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos33.prefixCount (A : Set Nat) (N : Nat) : Nat :=
  fun A N => Finset.card (Finset.filter (fun x => Membership.mem A x) (Finset.Icc 1 N))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos33.normalizedPrefixRatio
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos33.normalizedPrefixRatio (A : Set Nat) (N : Nat) : Real :=
  fun A N => HDiv.hDiv (↑(Erdos33.prefixCount A N)) (Real.sqrt ↑N)

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos33.IsSquareAdditiveComplement
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos33.IsSquareAdditiveComplement (A : Set Nat) : Prop :=
  fun A => ∀ (n : Nat), Exists fun a => And (Membership.mem A a) (Exists fun k => Eq n (HAdd.hAdd (HPow.hPow k 2) a))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos33.AdditiveBasisCondition
core_notation_audit.declaration:
def Erdos33.AdditiveBasisCondition (A : Set Nat) : Prop :=
  fun A => ∀ (k : Nat), Exists fun n => Exists fun a => And (Membership.mem A a) (Eq k (HAdd.hAdd a (HPow.hPow n 2)))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos33.erdos_33_variants_one_mem_lowerBounds
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos33.erdos_33_variants_one_mem_lowerBounds :
  LT.lt 1
    (iInf fun A =>
      Filter.limsup
        (fun N => HDiv.hDiv (↑(Set.ncard (Inter.inter (Subtype.val A) (Set.Icc 1 N)))) (Real.toEReal (Real.sqrt ↑N)))
        Filter.atTop)

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos33.erdos_33_variants_vanDoorn
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos33.erdos_33_variants_vanDoorn :
  LE.le
    (iInf fun A =>
      Filter.limsup
        (fun N => HDiv.hDiv (↑(Set.ncard (Inter.inter (Subtype.val A) (Set.Icc 1 N)))) (Real.toEReal (Real.sqrt ↑N)))
        Filter.atTop)
    (Real.toEReal (HMul.hMul 2 (HPow.hPow Real.goldenRatio (5 / 2))))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos33.sixty_three_fiftieths_le_iInf_limsup
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos33.sixty_three_fiftieths_le_iInf_limsup :
  LE.le (Real.toEReal (63 / 50))
    (iInf fun A =>
      Filter.limsup
        (fun N => HDiv.hDiv (↑(Set.ncard (Inter.inter (Subtype.val A) (Set.Icc 1 N)))) (Real.toEReal (Real.sqrt ↑N)))
        Filter.atTop)

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos33.exists_ge_sixty_three_fiftieths_normalizedPrefixRatio
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos33.exists_ge_sixty_three_fiftieths_normalizedPrefixRatio {A : Set Nat} (hA : Erdos33.IsSquareAdditiveComplement A)
  (M : Nat) : Exists fun N => And (LE.le M N) (LE.le (63 / 50) (Erdos33.normalizedPrefixRatio A N))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos33.additiveBasisCondition_vanDoornUnion
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos33.additiveBasisCondition_vanDoornUnion {M : Nat → Nat} (hM : ∀ (j : Nat), LE.le 1 (M j)) :
  Erdos33.AdditiveBasisCondition (Erdos33.vanDoornUnion M)

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos33.two_mul_sum_fibBlockWidth_div_sqrt_start_le
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos33.two_mul_sum_fibBlockWidth_div_sqrt_start_le {K : Nat} (hK : LE.le 1 K) :
  LE.le
    (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul 2 ↑(Finset.sum (Finset.range (HAdd.hAdd K 1)) fun j => Erdos33.fibBlockWidth j))
      (Real.sqrt ↑(Erdos33.vanDoornBlockStart Erdos33.fibBlockWidth K)))
    (HMul.hMul 2 (HPow.hPow Real.goldenRatio (5 / 2)))

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos33.one_hundred_twenty_seven_over_one_hundred_le_iInf_limsup
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos33.one_hundred_twenty_seven_over_one_hundred_le_iInf_limsup :
  LE.le (Real.toEReal (127 / 100))
    (iInf fun A =>
      Filter.limsup
        (fun N => HDiv.hDiv (↑(Set.ncard (Inter.inter (Subtype.val A) (Set.Icc 1 N)))) (Real.toEReal (Real.sqrt ↑N)))
        Filter.atTop)
